decisions.why: product names (AddOn EDOF IOL, Basis Z EDOF Toric Preloaded Hydrophobic IOL, ARTIS Symbiose Multifocal Preloaded IOL) are all intraocular lenses
single product, ARTIS PRIME Enhanced Monofocal IOL, an intraocular lens
products (ARTIS PL E/M/AIALA DRY preloaded IOLs) are intraocular lenses
products (PMMA anterior/posterior chamber IOL) are intraocular lenses
single product, ARTIS T PL E Monofocal Toric Hydrophobic Preloaded IOL, an intraocular lens
AddOn trifocal/refractive toric/refractive IOL products are secondary piggyback intraocular lenses
capsular tension rings are cataract-surgery devices implanted alongside an IOL to stabilise the capsular bag, sold as part of the same IOL-surgery product line
products (HealaFlow, Esnoper Clip VCLIP, Esnoper V2000 Glaucoma Implant) are named glaucoma drainage/implant devices
viscoelastic products (AJL VISC, sodium hyaluronate solutions) are single-use ophthalmic surgical consumables used during cataract/anterior-segment surgery
HPMC/eyegel viscoelastic products are the same single-use ophthalmic surgical consumable class as the Viscoelastic division
products (corneal knives, iris retractor, corneal trephines) are single-use ophthalmic surgical consumables
products (PDMS silicone oil, glass syringe, macular buckle) are single-use/implantable vitreoretinal surgery consumables
products (AJL/ENDO-K intracorneal ring segments for keratoconus/refractive correction) are ophthalmic surgical implants/consumables
products (orbital implants, palpebral implants, conformers) are ophthalmic surgical implants used in oculoplastic/socket surgery
single product, the Canabrava Ring, an intracorneal ring segment implant for keratoconus
